assignments.reason: The holy mouth of the tzaddik is the same essential reality as דבור הקדוש (holy speech), the dominant node of Package 1. The Torah states 'שֶׁהַצַּדִּיק הָאֱמֶת מְקַבֵּל דִּבּוּר פִּיו הַקָּדוֹשׁ מִבַּעֲלֵי צְדָקָה' — the tzaddik's holy mouth is the vessel of holy speech. Its essential nature is the great tzaddik's sacred utterance, the defining identity of Package 1.

assignments.node_id: נצול הצדיק האמת מפגם הצדקה שלהם
assignments.reason: The true tzaddik being saved from the damage of tainted charity is a protective outcome for the great tzaddik and his holy speech. The Torah explains that when wicked donors' charity reaches the tzaddik, it damages his פה קדוש (holy mouth). Being saved from that damage is the preservation of the great tzaddik's holy speech — the core identity of Package 1. The subject is the true tzaddik (צדיקים הגדולים) and the object of protection is his דבור הקדוש.

The existence of the liars/hypocrites is the defining phenomenon of the false-prophet domain. The Torah uses 'השקרנים' interchangeably with 'צבועים' and 'נביאי השקר' — they are the very figures that Package 5 describes. Though their existence paradoxically benefits the true tzaddik (a causal effect), the essential nature of 'the liars exist' is the false-prophet reality itself.

assignments.node_id: אלו הרשעים הנותנים צדקה פונין אליהם ונותנין להם
assignments.reason: The wicked donors turning to the false prophets and giving them charity describes the parasitic feeding mechanism of the false-prophet domain. The essential dynamic here is the false prophets attracting and absorbing tainted charity — 'הַכְשִׁילֵם בַּעֲנִיִּים שֶׁאֵינָם מְהֻגָּנִים'. The subject turns toward the liars (Package 5); the node's identity is defined by the false prophets' power to draw the wicked to themselves. This is the active expression of the false-prophet domain's parasitic nature.

This node is the expanded descriptive form of יב"ק — the acronym for יחוד ברכה קדושה (unity, blessing, holiness). Package 6 already contains יב"ק as its dominant node. This node's essential nature is identical: the tripartite holy quality of unity-blessing-holiness that flows from charity. The Torah states 'עַל־יְדֵי הַצְּדָקָה נַעֲשֶׂה בְּחִינַת יַבֹּק, הַיְנוּ: יִחוּד בְּרָכָה קְדֻשָּׁה'.
